settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Upload a square image (at least 32x32px). PNG or SVG. Used for the browser tab icon and home-screen icon on mobile.

settings.label: Logo (for search engines)
settings.info: Square or wide logo, at least 512px. Used in Organization structured data and as the last-resort social share image. Not shown on the storefront.

settings.label: Business name
settings.info: Leave blank to use the store name.

settings.label: Business description
settings.info: One or two sentences describing the business. Used in Organization structured data.

settings.label: Homepage title suffix
settings.info: Added after the store name in the browser title, e.g. "THE EDIT | Original Imported Skincare in Pakistan". Keep the whole title under 60 characters. An SEO title set in Online Store > Preferences overrides this.

settings.label: Homepage H1 (screen readers and search engines)
settings.info: The homepage has no visible top-level heading, because its first section starts at H2. This is rendered as a visually hidden H1 so the page has one. Write it as a plain description of the store, not a list of keywords.

settings.label: Homepage meta description
settings.info: Under 155 characters. Used when no description is set in Online Store > Preferences.
settings.default: Original skincare in Pakistan: pharmacy-sourced CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, ISDIN and Avene, plus CHAM as official partner. Sealed, batch codes intact.

settings.label: Default social share image
settings.info: Shown when a page with no image of its own is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook or X. 1200x630px works best.

settings.label: Google Search Console verification code
settings.info: The content value of the google-site-verification meta tag. Leave blank if Search Console is verified by DNS or Google Analytics.

settings.label: Phone
settings.info: In international format, e.g. +923001234567.

settings.label: Area served
settings.info: Country code of the market you sell to.

settings.label: YouTube URL
settings.info: The store's own channel only. Do not use a supplier's or brand's channel here.

settings.label: t:settings_schema.commerce.free_shipping_threshold.label
settings.info: t:settings_schema.commerce.free_shipping_threshold.info

settings.label: Automatic discount shown on product prices (%)
settings.info: MUST match the Shopify automatic discount in Discounts admin. The theme only DISPLAYS this percentage and puts it in the Product structured data; Shopify decides what is actually charged. If the two disagree, customers see one price and pay another. Applies only to products with no compare-at price and without the 'no-discount' tag — CHAM products use real compare-at prices instead.

settings.content: Only turn this on when a matching automatic discount (or other reward) is live in Shopify admin > Discounts, with the same minimum amount. The theme only displays progress; Shopify decides what is actually given at checkout.

settings.label: Show CHAM offer progress
settings.info: When the cart holds the CHAM mask or cream, shows progress towards the live CHAM offers: buy 2 save 35% in total, buy 3 masks get a free cream, buy 3 creams get 1 free. Turn off if those automatic discounts change or end. Takes the place of the spend bar below while CHAM is in the cart.

settings.label: Reward threshold (PKR)
settings.info: Cart subtotal needed to reach the reward, in whole rupees, e.g. 10000.

settings.label: Message before the threshold
settings.info: [amount] is replaced with the amount still to spend.
settings.default: Spend [amount] more to unlock your reward

settings.label: Show product recommendations
settings.info: Uses Shopify's product recommendations for the first item in the cart. Loaded only when the drawer is opened.

settings.label: Fallback collection
settings.info: Shown when Shopify has no recommendations for the product yet.

settings.label: Paired products only suggest each other
settings.info: When the cart holds one product of the pair, the other is the only suggestion; with both in the cart, no suggestions are shown. Blank pickers use the CHAM Brightening Face Mask and The Brightening Cream.

settings.label: Show "You save" per item and total savings
settings.info: Calculated from real compare-at prices and applied discounts only.

settings.label: Show item options and bundle contents

settings.content: While CHAM is in the cart, shows above Checkout how long is left to order for same-day dispatch, e.g. "Order within 2h 14m and it ships today". After the cutoff, or on a non-dispatch day, it says when the order will ship instead. Turn it off on holidays or any day orders will not go out.

settings.label: Trust row text
settings.info: Separate items with ·. Keep to facts in your store policies.
settings.default: Pay cash when your order arrives · Free delivery across Pakistan
